annotations.title: Extract Structured SaaS Pricing Tiers & Billing Models

description: Convert any SaaS root domain or `/pricing` URL into structured JSON pricing tiers, monthly/annual prices, free-plan availability, per-seat vs. usage-based billing flags, and clean LLM-ready Markdown (`corridordata/saas-pricing-page-structured-extractor`).

includeCleanMarkdown.description: Include token-efficient Markdown of the pricing page alongside structured tier JSON.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

urls.description: List of SaaS pricing URLs or domains (e.g. ['https://linear.app/pricing', 'https://resend.com/pricing']).

name: extract_saas_pricing
